description: This file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveService class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard Service namespace. It provides a service layer for handling employee leave data, primarily interacting with the EmployeeOnLeaveDao data access object. The class includes a constant configuration key and a getter method to access the DAO, initializing it if not already set.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveService
classes.description: Service class providing access to employee leave data, encapsulating the data access object and configuration key.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeOnLeaveDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.
